text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners early, then made no trades for seven periods; I should make deliberate decisions rather than let gains, regret, or inertia drive them.","I should judge positions by their role and risk in the whole portfolio, not by whether each one is above or below my purchase price.","Because past price changes do not predict future returns, I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and follow a consistent plan instead."]}
